staged.readerSentence: Daniel Keenan — Wikipedia search API, DISALLOWED by robots.txt — owed: campaignSite, positions, bio, photo, contact: the route closed DISCOVERED. DISALLOWED BY THE HOST'S OWN robots.txt, read 2026-09-01. `User-agent: *` carries `Disallow: /w/` with exactly two exceptions — `Allow: /w/api.php?action=mobileview&` and `Allow: /w/load.php?` — and a search query is neither. THIS IS NOT A WALL: the host is not refusing us, it is telling us not to ask, and RULING 53's re-walk clock applies to walls and never to disallows. The compliant route to the same facts is the Wikimedia REST API on api.wikimedia.org, whose /robots.txt answered HTTP 301 to a documentation page on 2026-09-01 — NO ROBOTS DOCUMENT, which is an absence of restrictions and never a grant, recorded CANNOT_TELL under RULING 182 and owed a permission reading before it is opened.
